reviews.reviewText:
Mostly MCQs were conceptual, some from handouts.
Subjective (from files):
1. General pressure for privatization.
2. Supply pressure for privatization.
3. Role of technology in economic growth of country.
4. Describe educational voucher.
5. Vision of environmental education.
6. Describe lack of food in developing countries.
7. Describe migratory trends.

Short Questions (3 marks):
1. Right time to give learning training to teachers.
2. Role of ideological theories and culture in population education.
3. Supply side.
4. Eraut dimensions.

Long Questions (5 marks):
1. Diversity of private education in Pakistan.
2. Challenge in implementing the mother tongue as medium of instruction.
3. Models of education.
